passages.text: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam’s reign over Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah became king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king of Israel.
He reigned for many years.
In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam’s reign, something important happened.
Azariah became king of Judah.
Azariah was the son of Amaziah.
Amaziah had also been king of Judah.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲמַצְיָ֖ה מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother’s name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was sixteen years old when he became king.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for fifty-two years.
His mother’s name was Jecoliah.
Jecoliah was from Jerusalem.
passages.original: בֶּן־ שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְכָלְיָ֖הוּ מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
Azariah was the son of Amaziah.
Azariah did what was right.
He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Azariah acted as his father Amaziah had acted.
Amaziah had also done what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king in Jerusalem.
He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
But he did not remove the high places.
The people still offered sacrifices at the high places.
The people still burned incense at the high places.
passages.original: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And the LORD afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, so that he lived in a separate house while his son Jotham had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD afflicted the king with leprosy.
The king had leprosy until the day he died.
The king lived in a separate house.
Jotham was the king’s son.
Jotham had charge of the palace.
Jotham governed the people of the land.
passages.original: וַיְנַגַּ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וַיְהִ֤י מְצֹרָע֙ עַד־ י֣וֹם מֹת֔וֹ וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּבֵ֣ית הַחָפְשִׁ֑ית וְיוֹתָ֤ם בֶּן־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ הַבַּ֔יִת שֹׁפֵ֖ט אֶת־ עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Azariah, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
He did many things during his reign.
The rest of Azariah’s deeds are recorded.
All his accomplishments are written down.
You can find them in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And Azariah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in the City of David. And his son Jotham reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
Azariah died.
People buried Azariah with his ancestors.
They buried him in the City of David.
Jotham was Azariah’s son.
Jotham became king after Azariah.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עֲזַרְיָה֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria six months.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
He ruled for many years.
In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah’s reign, Zechariah became king of Israel.
Zechariah was the son of Jeroboam.
Zechariah ruled in Samaria.
He was king for six months.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּשְׁמֹנֶה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ זְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יָרָבְעָ֧ם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן שִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done. He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was king of Israel.
Zechariah did evil.
The LORD saw Zechariah’s evil.
Zechariah acted like his fathers before him.
Zechariah did not turn away from sin.
Jeroboam son of Nebat led Israel into sin.
Zechariah continued in Jeroboam’s sins.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָ֑יו לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽחַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah, struck him down and killed him in front of the people, and reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Shallum was the son of Jabesh.
Shallum conspired against Zechariah.
Shallum struck Zechariah down in front of the people.
Shallum killed Zechariah.
Shallum became king in Zechariah’s place.
passages.original: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָיו֙ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן־ יָבֵ֔שׁ וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ קָֽבָלְ־ עָ֖ם וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Zechariah, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was a king of Israel.
Other things Zechariah did are not listed here.
People wrote about Zechariah’s other deeds in a book.
This book is called the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So the word of the LORD spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: “Four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke a word to Jehu.
God made a promise to Jehu.
God said, “Four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel.”
This promise came true.
Four generations of Jehu’s descendants ruled over Israel.
passages.original: ה֣וּא דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֶל־ יֵהוּא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּנֵ֣י רְבִיעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְךָ֖ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃פ

passages.text: In the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah’s reign over Judah, Shallum son of Jabesh became king, and he reigned in Samaria one full month.
passages.sermon:
Shallum was the son of Jabesh.
Shallum became king.
Uzziah was king of Judah.
Uzziah had reigned for thirty-nine years.
Shallum became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah’s reign.
Shallum ruled in Samaria.
Shallum ruled for one month.
passages.original: שַׁלּ֤וּם בֶּן־ יָבֵישׁ֙ מָלַ֔ךְ בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְעֻזִיָּ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ יֶֽרַח־ יָמִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Then Menahem son of Gadi went up from Tirzah to Samaria, struck down and killed Shallum son of Jabesh, and reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Menahem was the son of Gadi.
He lived in Tirzah.
Menahem left Tirzah.
He went to Samaria.
Shallum was the son of Jabesh.
Shallum was in Samaria.
Menahem struck down Shallum in Samaria.
Menahem killed Shallum.
Menahem became king after Shallum.
passages.original: וַיַּעַל֩ מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן־ גָּדִ֜י מִתִּרְצָ֗ה וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַיַּ֛ךְ אֶת־ שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן־ יָבֵ֖ישׁ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיְמִיתֵ֖הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Shallum, along with the conspiracy he led, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Shallum was king of Israel.
He was the son of Jabesh.
He ruled in Samaria.
He led a conspiracy.
Other acts of Shallum are recorded.
The Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel contains these records.
This book includes the details of his conspiracy.
passages.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י שַׁלּ֔וּם וְקִשְׁר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָשָׁ֑ר הִנָּ֣ם כְּתֻבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: At that time Menahem, starting from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in its vicinity, because they would not open their gates. So he attacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.
passages.sermon:
Menahem was the king of Israel.
He started from Tirzah.
He attacked the city of Tiphsah.
He attacked everyone in Tiphsah and its surrounding area.
The people of Tiphsah did not open their gates to him.
Because of this, Menahem attacked the city.
He killed all the pregnant women in Tiphsah by ripping them open.
passages.original: אָ֣ז יַכֶּֽה־ מְ֠נַחֵם אֶת־ תִּפְסַ֨ח וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלֶ֙יהָ֙ מִתִּרְצָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א פָתַ֖ח וַיַּ֑ךְ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הֶהָ֥רוֹתֶ֖יהָ בִּקֵּֽעַ׃פ

passages.text: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
He ruled for thirty-nine years.
In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah’s reign, Menahem became king of Israel.
Menahem was the son of Gadi.
Menahem ruled Israel for ten years.
He ruled in Samaria.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן־ גָּדִ֧י עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and throughout his reign he did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Menahem was king of Israel.
He did evil in the sight of the LORD.
He did not turn away from sin.
Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to sin.
Menahem followed these same sins all his days.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֠ר מֵעַ֨ל חַטֹּ֜אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom.
passages.sermon:
Pul was the king of Assyria.
Pul invaded the land of Israel.
Menahem was the king of Israel.
Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver.
Menahem did this to gain Pul’s support.
Menahem wanted to strengthen his hold on the kingdom.
passages.original: בָּ֣א פ֤וּל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מְנַחֵם֙ לְפ֔וּל אֶ֖לֶף כִּכַּר־ כָּ֑סֶף לִהְי֤וֹת יָדָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ לְהַחֲזִ֥יק הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Menahem exacted this money from each of the wealthy men of Israel—fifty shekels of silver from each man—to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria withdrew and did not remain in the land.
passages.sermon:
Menahem was king of Israel.
He needed to give silver to the king of Assyria.
Menahem took money from the wealthy men of Israel.
He took fifty shekels of silver from each man.
He gave this silver to the king of Assyria.
The king of Assyria then left the land.
He did not stay in Israel.
passages.original: וַיֹּצֵא֩ מְנַחֵ֨ם אֶת־ הַכֶּ֜סֶף עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל כָּל־ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל לָתֵת֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר חֲמִשִּׁ֧ים שְׁקָלִ֛ים כֶּ֖סֶף לְאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְלֹא־ עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Menahem, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
passages.sermon:
Menahem was king of Israel.
He did many things during his reign.
The rest of Menahem’s deeds are recorded.
All his accomplishments are written down.
They are in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י מְנַחֵ֖ם וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Menahem rested with his fathers, and his son Pekahiah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Menahem was king of Israel.
Menahem died.
Menahem was buried with his ancestors.
Pekahiah was Menahem’s son.
Pekahiah became king after Menahem.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב מְנַחֵ֖ם עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ פְּקַחְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

passages.text: In the fiftieth year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria two years.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
He ruled for many years.
In the fiftieth year of Azariah’s reign, something important happened.
Pekahiah became king of Israel.
Pekahiah was the son of Menahem.
Pekahiah ruled in Samaria.
He was king for two years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַת֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ פְּקַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶן־ מְנַחֵ֧ם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Pekah was king of Israel.
Pekah did evil.
The LORD saw Pekah’s evil.
Pekah did not turn away from sin.
Jeroboam son of Nebat led Israel into sin.
Pekah continued in the same sins as Jeroboam.
Pekah did not stop Israel from sinning.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽחַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then his officer, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him along with Argob, Arieh, and fifty men of Gilead. And at the citadel of the king’s palace in Samaria, Pekah struck down and killed Pekahiah and reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Pekah was the son of Remaliah.
Pekah was an officer of King Pekahiah of Israel.
Pekah conspired against King Pekahiah.
Argob and Arieh joined Pekah in the plot.
Fifty men from Gilead also joined them.
They went to the king’s palace in Samaria.
They attacked Pekahiah in the citadel of the palace.
Pekah struck down Pekahiah.
Pekah killed Pekahiah.
Pekah became king in Pekahiah’s place.
passages.original: וַיִּקְשֹׁ֣ר עָלָיו֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ שָׁלִישׁ֗וֹ וַיַּכֵּ֨הוּ בְשֹׁמְר֜וֹן בְּאַרְמ֤וֹן בֵּית־ מֶלֶךְ אֶת־ אַרְגֹּ֣ב וְאֶת־ הָאַרְיֵ֔ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָדִ֑ים וַיְמִיתֵ֖הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, along with all his accomplishments, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Pekahiah was a king of Israel.
He did many things during his reign.
Other acts of Pekahiah are not listed here.
All his accomplishments are recorded elsewhere.
They are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י פְקַחְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: In the fifty-second year of Azariah’s reign over Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria twenty years.
passages.sermon:
Azariah was king of Judah.
He ruled for fifty-two years.
In the fifty-second year of Azariah’s reign, Pekah became king of Israel.
Pekah was the son of Remaliah.
Pekah ruled in Samaria.
He reigned for twenty years.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ פֶּ֣קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit.
passages.sermon:
Pekah was king of Israel.
Pekah did evil in the sight of the LORD.
Pekah did not turn away from sin.
Jeroboam son of Nebat led Israel into sin.
Pekah continued in the same sins as Jeroboam.
Pekah did not stop Israel from sinning.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִן־ חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and captured Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and he took the people as captives to Assyria.
passages.sermon:
Pekah was king of Israel.
Tiglath-pileser was king of Assyria.
During the days of Pekah, Tiglath-pileser came to Israel.
Tiglath-pileser captured Ijon.
He captured Abel-beth-maacah.
He captured Janoah.
He captured Kedesh.
He captured Hazor.
He captured Gilead.
He captured Galilee.
He captured all the land of Naphtali.
Tiglath-pileser took the people from these places.
He took them as captives to Assyria.
passages.original: בִּימֵ֞י פֶּ֣קַח מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בָּא֮ תִּגְלַ֣ת פִּלְאֶסֶר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֒ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ עִיּ֡וֹן וְאֶת־ אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית־ מַעֲכָ֡ה וְאֶת־ יָ֠נוֹחַ וְאֶת־ קֶ֨דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ חָצ֤וֹר וְאֶת־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְאֶת־ הַגָּלִ֔ילָה כֹּ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַיַּגְלֵ֖ם אַשּֽׁוּרָה׃

passages.text: Then Hoshea son of Elah led a conspiracy against Pekah son of Remaliah. In the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah, Hoshea attacked Pekah, killed him, and reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Hoshea was the son of Elah.
Pekah was the son of Remaliah.
Jotham was the son of Uzziah.
Hoshea led a conspiracy against Pekah.
Hoshea attacked Pekah.
Hoshea killed Pekah.
Hoshea became king instead of Pekah.
This happened in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.
passages.original: וַיִּקְשָׁר־ קֶ֜שֶׁר הוֹשֵׁ֣עַ בֶּן־ אֵלָ֗ה עַל־ פֶּ֙קַח֙ בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֔הוּ וַיַּכֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיְמִיתֵ֔הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑יו בִּשְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְיוֹתָ֖ם בֶּן־ עֻזִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Pekah, along with all his accomplishments, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Pekah was a king of Israel.
He did many things during his reign.
The rest of Pekah’s acts are recorded.
All his accomplishments are written down.
These records are in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
passages.original: וְיֶ֥תֶר דִּבְרֵי־ פֶ֖קַח וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: In the second year of the reign of Pekah son of Remaliah over Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah became king of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Pekah was the son of Remaliah.
Pekah was king of Israel.
Jotham was the son of Uzziah.
Jotham became king of Judah.
This happened in the second year of Pekah’s reign over Israel.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְפֶ֥קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בֶּן־ עֻזִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother’s name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.
passages.sermon:
Jotham became king of Judah when he was twenty-five years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years.
His mother was Jerusha.
Jerusha was the daughter of Zadok.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖א בַּת־ צָדֽוֹק׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham did what was right.
The LORD saw Jotham’s actions as right.
Jotham acted like his father Uzziah.
Uzziah had also done what was right.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֛ה עֻזִיָּ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יו עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king in Jerusalem.
Jotham did not remove the high places.
The people still offered sacrifices at the high places.
The people still burned incense at the high places.
Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD.
passages.original: רַ֤ק הַבָּמוֹת֙ לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ ע֗וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת־ שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה הָעֶלְיֽוֹן׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Jotham, along with his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham did many things.
Jotham accomplished much.
Writers recorded the rest of Jotham’s acts.
They wrote these things in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: (In those days the LORD began to send Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah against Judah.)
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Judah was the southern kingdom of Israel.
In those days, the LORD began to act against Judah.
The LORD sent Rezin.
Rezin was the king of Aram.
The LORD also sent Pekah.
Pekah was the son of Remaliah.
Pekah was also a king.
The LORD sent Rezin and Pekah against Judah.
passages.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה לְהַשְׁלִ֙יחַ֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה רְצִ֖ין מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וְאֵ֖ת פֶּ֥קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָֽהוּ׃

passages.text: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David his father. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jotham was king of Judah.
Jotham died.
People buried Jotham with his ancestors.
They buried him in the City of David.
David was Jotham’s ancestor.
After Jotham died, his son Ahaz became king.
Ahaz ruled in Jotham’s place.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
